criteria.description: Correctly evaluates the sentence as true, with correct reasoning for both sub-terms.

solutions.fullSolution: not P = true (since P=false). Q or R = true (since R=true). true and true = true.

criteria.description: Correctly distinguishes entailment as a semantic/model fact from derivability as a procedural fact.

solutions.fullSolution: KB |= alpha is a semantic fact about models, independent of any algorithm. KB |-_i alpha is about what a specific procedure i can actually produce. Sound but not complete: everything i derives is genuinely entailed (no false conclusions), but some genuinely entailed sentences are not derived by i, i.e. trustworthy but not exhaustive.

criteria.description: Correctly derives B from C, D, and C∧D⇒B.
Correctly derives A from B and B⇒A.

solutions.fullSolution: From C, D, and C∧D⇒B, Modus Ponens gives B. Then from B and B⇒A, Modus Ponens gives A. Firing whichever rule's premises are currently satisfied, repeatedly, is forward chaining.
